title: Algorithm in chemistry: molecular logic gate-based data protection
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,3681-3735
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01104J, Review Article
Yu Dong, Shiyu Feng, Weiguo Huang, Xiang Ma
This review focuses on stimuli-responsive material (SRM)-based data protection, emphasizing the integration of intricate logic and algorithms in SRM-constructed hardware. It also discusses current challenges and future directions of the field.
